title: Burns Fatal to John R. Large
text:
Burns Fatal to
John R. Large

SAVOY.—Severe burns received last Monday while working on an electric line in Tyler were fatal Saturday to John Raymond Large, 50, of Savoy. He died in Parkland Hospital, Dallas.

Funeral will be in Savoy Church of Christ Monday at about 2:30 p. m. with the pastor, Cole Tidwell, officiating. Burial, directed by Earnheart Funeral Home of Whitewright, will be in Sunnyside Cemetery here.

Mr. Large was born in Savoy, a son of the late John and Eliza Large. He was a deacon in the Church of Christ.

Survivors include his wife, the former Miss Bonnie Guffie; two daughters, Mrs. Dolores Ann Griffith of Fort Worth and Miss Joyce Carroll Large of Savoy; two brothers, Floyd and Russell Large, and one sister, Miss Elizabeth Large, of Savoy.

Mr. Large for a number of years operated a grocery-meat market in Savoy. The building which housed the store burned last year, destroying the store and several other businesses.
